attempts.summary: Configured PostgreSQL 15 streaming replication across the RHEL 7.9 cluster: node1 is the writable primary, node2 and node3 are read-only streaming standbys. Verified data replicates from primary to both standbys, standbys reject writes, and the setup survives a sequential restart of all three nodes (standbys first, primary last) with full replication and data recovery confirmed afterward.
